text:
Type: black metal lantern for a block candle
Use: holding a candle for soft light on a table, floor or windowsill; living room, dining room, hallway, terrace
Style: traditional, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: black powder-coated steel, clear glass panels
Colors: black, clear glass
Shape: square box lantern with four glass sides, a hinged door, a slotted roof crown and a ring handle on top, upright and open, medium size
Feel: cozy, warm, nostalgic, inviting
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, wool throws, green plants; rustic, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: BORRBY
product.description: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
